conflicts.wo2_value: Single-blind (NOT double-blind) — authors' names/affiliations are on the manuscript and known to editors and reviewers; reviewers' identities are not disclosed to authors. (source: https://cljournal.org/submissions.html)
conflicts.why_flagged: 現有條目與 WO2 對審稿匿名制度的描述直接矛盾（雙盲 vs 單盲），且 WO2 引用的是期刊自己的投稿頁面，證據強度不低，需要人工查證 cljournal.org/submissions.html 後再決定是否修正，不宜自動覆蓋既有內容。
